items.title: OBR cuts UK growth forecast for 2027 in John Healey's first budget
items.summary: According to The Guardian, the Office for Budget Responsibility has lowered its 2027 growth estimate to 1% amid economic pressures from the Middle East conflict.

items.title: Chancellor reinstates £20,000 Cash ISA annual allowance
items.summary: According to Investment Week, john Healey has reversed plans to lower the Cash ISA limit to £12,000 and introduced proposals for a new Starter ISA.

items.title: Stamp Duty on shares to be replaced by Securities Transfer Tax
items.summary: According to Investment Week, hM Treasury plans to replace Stamp Duty and Stamp Duty Reserve Tax on shares with a new Securities Transfer Tax by late 2027.

items.title: Chancellor John Healey delivers maiden Budget with pledges on household energy and ISAs
items.summary: According to Investment Week, chancellor John Healey has promised breathing space on living costs in his first Budget while adhering to strict fiscal rules amid global economic uncertainty.

items.title: FCA issues warning over unauthorised entity Mobile Savings Plan
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has published an official warning against Mobile Savings Plan, advising UK consumers to avoid dealing with the firm.

items.title: Chancellor John Healey expected to reverse planned cut to cash ISA allowance
items.summary: According to The Guardian, chancellor John Healey will reportedly scrap his predecessor's planned reduction of the annual cash ISA limit from £20,000 to £12,000 in his upcoming budget.
